name: go-test-quality
description: > Go testing patterns for production-grade code: subtests, test helpers, fixtures, golden files, httptest, testcontainers, fuzz testing, and testing/synctest. Covers mocking strategies, test isolation, coverage analysis, and test design philosophy. Use when writing tests, improving coverage, reviewing test quality, setting up test infrastructure, or choosing a testing approach. Trigger examples: "add tests", "improve coverage", "write tests for this", "test helpers", "mock this dependency", "int
author: eduardo-sl
summary_zh: 面向生产级 Go 项目的测试实践指南，适合编写测试、提升覆盖率、隔离依赖及评审测试质量。
